name: Lavina L38RE remote-controlled grinder
summary: Large electric planetary concrete grinder (923 mm working width, 18.5 kW) that the operator drives from a two-joystick remote control or walks behind; launched by Superabrasive in 2026 and sold in Germany by F&V Flooring Solutions.

germany.statusNote: German Lavina distributor F&V Flooring Solutions (Altendiez) lists the EU model L38REUB with a data sheet but no price; Superabrasive sells only through distributors. The only list price is the US MSRP of the US high-voltage model.

priceOther.market: US MSRP of the US high-voltage model L38REHVB

sellers.name: F&V Flooring Solutions GmbH & Co. KG
sellers.note: Named by Superabrasive as its distributor for Germany and Austria; lists "L38REUB Arbeitsbreite 923mm" with a German data sheet. No price on the page.

specs.label: Working width
specs.conditions: German distributor figure; maker gives 36.5 in

specs.label: Drive power
specs.value: dual AGM battery for the machine drive
specs.quote: Powered by a robust dual AGM battery setup for the machine drive

notes: Remote-controlled, not autonomous: remote with emergency stop, two joysticks and switches for engine rpm, tool direction, speed and swing correction; shows voltage, battery, load, rpm and maintenance alerts.
Can be switched to manual walk-behind mode at any time; removable magnetic key switch.
Battery-driven wheels and an integrated transport wheel; mains-powered grinding head.
